newCriteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
newCriteria.requirement: A component receiving keyboard focus is not entirely hidden by author-created content
newCriteria.commonCause: Sticky headers, cookie bars, chat widgets

newCriteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced)
newCriteria.requirement: No part of the focused component is hidden by author-created content

newCriteria.name: Focus Appearance
newCriteria.requirement: Focus indicator at least 2 CSS pixels thick around the component, with 3:1 contrast
newCriteria.commonCause: Thin or low-contrast custom focus rings

newCriteria.name: Dragging Movements
newCriteria.requirement: Anything achievable by dragging is also achievable with a single pointer action unless dragging is essential
newCriteria.commonCause: Sliders, reorderable lists, kanban boards, map panning

newCriteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
newCriteria.requirement: Targets are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, or spaced so a 24 px circle around each does not overlap another
newCriteria.commonCause: Toast close buttons, table row icons, pagination

newCriteria.name: Consistent Help
newCriteria.requirement: Help mechanisms appear in the same relative order on every page that includes them
newCriteria.commonCause: Help link moving between header and footer

newCriteria.name: Redundant Entry
newCriteria.requirement: Information already entered in a process is not requested again, unless essential
newCriteria.commonCause: Multi-step checkout re-asking for an address

newCriteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Minimum)
newCriteria.requirement: No authentication step requires a cognitive function test without an alternative or assistance mechanism
newCriteria.commonCause: Blocking paste in password fields, puzzle-only sign-in

newCriteria.name: Accessible Authentication (Enhanced)
newCriteria.requirement: As 3.3.8, without the object or personal content recognition exception
newCriteria.commonCause: Image recognition as the only alternative

otherCriteriaCited.relevance: 3:1 for control boundaries and meaningful graphics

items.guideline: Make clear what the system can do

aiFeatureStates.requirement: Say what this can do, give concrete example prompts, and say what it cannot do
Stream partial output past about a second; name the current step for multi-step work

Direct route from the account page

limitations: Automated accessibility data detects roughly a third of real problems, so crawl figures understate the true failure rate
WebAIM measures home pages, so signed-in application screens are not represented
Browser availability moves monthly; every status is as of 2026-08-11
Survey figures (State of CSS, FIDO consumer surveys) are self-selected
Vendor research on its own design system is not independent
US litigation counts are not reconcilable across trackers
No usability testing was conducted for this report; it synthesises published evidence
Mobile app specifics are covered only where they set a numeric standard
Spatial, voice, and automotive interfaces are out of scope and would change several thresholds
